company.name: Gilead Sciences
company.shortDescription: Gilead Sciences develops and markets biopharmaceutical therapies, focusing on antiviral, oncology, and inflammatory diseases.
company.description:
Gilead Sciences is a research-based biopharmaceutical company that discovers, develops, and commercializes innovative medicines to address unmet medical needs. With each discovery and experimental drug candidate, they seek to improve the care of patients suffering from life-threatening diseases.

Gilead's primary areas of focus include HIV/AIDS, liver disease, and serious cardiovascular and respiratory conditions.

aiResearchSummary.text: Gilead Sciences is researching and developing bridged tricyclic carbamoylpyridone compounds and capsid inhibitors for the treatment and prevention of HIV, as well as pharmaceutical formulations of bictegravir and lenacapavir. Their work includes SARS-CoV-2 main protease inhibitors, antiviral indolinyl compounds, and methods for treating viral infections such as hepatitis B, respiratory syncytial virus, and poxvirus. These efforts span small molecules, antibodies, and immunogenic compositions for critical diseases.
